name: loader-check-build
command: bend tests/loader-boundary.bend -o build/loader-boundary-test.c && clang -O2 build/loader-boundary-test.c tests/loader-growth.c -Wl,--wrap=read -Wl,--wrap=close -o build/loader-boundary-wrapped-test -lpthread -lm && bend bench/advanced-main.bend -o build/advanced-main

limits.enforcement: transient user cgroup scope: MemoryMax, no swap; taskset; timeout; CPU rlimit; aggregate RSS backstop
